exposure: Reproductive characteristics (pregnancy history, abortion history, parity)
cohort: The study included 1120 Iranian women diagnosed with multiple sclerosis (PwMS), with a median diagnostic age of 31 and a disease duration of 6 years.
finding: Pregnancy and parity were found to affect disability in female PwMS, with a history of pregnancy or abortion associated with higher EDSS scores and multiparity before MS diagnosis linked to higher EDSS, while higher disability conversely correlated with decreased parity after MS diagnosis.
